answer: At epoch’s nadir, a sparrow must sing a nonce into a grove of 4096 microphones spaced by 17cm. Signals arriving outside a 3.9ms window are rejected; an extra fake shifts the sparrow’s timing by 1ms and must find a new 17cm spot, costing an attacker 14ms per identity—every spatial slot couples to the surrounding forest’s echo length, too steep to brute-force across bulk.
